bibl.title: The lex sacra from Ptolemais Revisited. A Note.
bibl.seg: Maryline G. Parca, The lex sacra from Ptolemais Revisited. A Note.
Antonio Ricciardetto, Nathan Carlig, Gabriel Nocchi Macedo & Magali de Haro Sanchez (edd.), Le médecin et le livre. Hommages à Marie-Hélène Marganne (Lecce, 2021) pp. 587-600.
bibl.note: The first-century BC lex sacra from Ptolemais (S.B. I, 3451 = S.E.G. XLIII, 1131) is significant because of the ways in which it conforms to and departs from purity rules known from across the ancient Greek world. Discusses the fourteen-line long text with particular attention to the pollution stemming from miscarriage, delivery and nursing, and child exposure. - The lex sacra from Ptolemais. - An (im)migrant's cult? [Demeter?].
